## September 4 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 766)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial story arcs, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 4** across three distinct eras of America's fabulous freelance insurance investigator on *Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar* starring Charles Russell (1949) and Bob Bailey (1956, 1960), western harmony legends The Sons of the Pioneers and Martha Mears on *10-2-4 Ranch* for Dr Pepper (1942, 1944), and dramatic reenactments of the tragic 1952 Southern tornadoes on *Disaster!* for the American Red Cross, Charles Russell (1949), Bob Bailey (1956, 1960), Bob Nolan (1942, 1944), and Don Dowd (1942–1960):
